facts.text: "I wanted a quiet dinner. The mask had other plans, and now the whole room is dancing."
facts.why: Stanley never says this. It is in quote marks and signed Stanley Ipkiss, so it reads as a film line. The famous lines belong to the Mask himself.
facts.fix: Ooh, somebody stop me! (sign it The Mask)

vibe.verdict: Somebody stop me and the Smokin Bongo cocktail print on a black and gold nightclub card, but the dessert has lost its sweet tooth line and nothing else is as loud as the film.
